overview: Councilor Matt Leming presents his platform for re-election to the City Council, highlighting his work on housing affordability, municipal budget stability, and veteran services.

items.title: Candidate Introduction and Background
items.summary: Councilor Matt Leming introduces his professional background as a scientist and naval officer while announcing his bid for a second term.

items.title: Fiscal and Housing Policy
items.summary: He discusses addressing Medford's budget constraints and housing costs, citing his support for a ballot initiative that funded teaching positions and road repairs.

items.title: Development and Zoning Initiatives
items.summary: Leming outlines his work on senior housing, the affordable housing trust, and proposed building regulations aimed at sustainable growth and historic preservation.

items.title: Transparency and Community Outreach
items.summary: The candidate highlights efforts to improve transparency through a council newsletter, live streaming of meetings, and regular office hours.

items.title: Veterans Services and Civil Rights
items.summary: Legislative work cited includes establishing a housing program for low-income veterans and supporting the Welcoming City Ordinance.
